summary: Wheaton Precious Metals filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated November 5, 2026, announcing its Board of Directors declared the fourth quarterly cash dividend for 2026 of US$0.195 per common share, an 18% increase over the fourth quarterly dividend declared in 2025. Record date is November 19, 2026, with payment on or about December 3, 2026 and ex-dividend date November 19, 2026. The dividend qualifies as an eligible dividend for Canadian income tax purposes. The company will issue shares under its optional Dividend Reinvestment Plan through treasury at Average Market Price without discount. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; watch for DRIP-driven share issuance and payout sustainability.
